segments.ja374:1.1: Sabbaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ samādāya, pāraṃ tiṇṇosi brāhmaṇa;
segments.ja374:1.3: Paccāgaccha lahuṃ khippaṃ, mampi tārehi dānito [dānibho (syā.)].
segments.ja374:2.1: Asanthutaṃ maṃ cirasanthutena, nimīni bhotī addhuvaṃ dhuvena;
segments.ja374:2.3: Mayāpi bhotī nimineyya aññaṃ, ito ahaṃ dūrataraṃ gamissaṃ.
segments.ja374:3.3: Nayīdha naccagītaṃ vā [nayidha naccaṃ vā gītaṃ vā (sī. syā. pī.)], tāḷaṃ vā susamāhitaṃ;
segments.ja374:3.5: Anamhikāle [anamhakāle (pī.)] susoṇi [sussoṇi (sī. syā. pī.)], kiṃ nu jagghasi sobhane [sobhaṇe (pī. ka.)].
segments.ja374:4.3: Jīno macchañca pesiñca, kapaṇo viya jhāyasi.
segments.ja374:5.3: Jīnā patiñca jārañca, maññe tvaññeva [mampi tvaññeva (sī. syā.), tvampi maññeva (pī.)] jhāyasi.
segments.ja374:6.3: Sā nūnāhaṃ ito gantvā, bhattu hessaṃ vasānugā.
segments.ja374:7.1: Yo hare mattikaṃ thālaṃ, kaṃsathālampi so hare;
segments.ja374:7.3: Katañceva [kataṃyeva (sī. syā. pī.)] tayā pāpaṃ, punapevaṃ karissasīti.
